title: Inference perf + VL forward fix session
content:
Session 2026-06-25: Fixed two critical inference performance issues + VL model forward.

## Changes Made

### 1. KVCache O(N²) → O(1) append (src/nn/kv_cache.rs, src/dtype.rs, src/nn/transformer.rs)
- **Problem**: `KVCache::append_packed` concatenated entire cache + new token every decode step via `Tensor::kvcache_append` (op dispatch + full tensor copy). O(N²) total for N tokens.
- **Fix**: Added `pre_allocated` flag, `filled_len` field, `capacity` field. New `set_packed_capacity(batch, capacity, dim)` pre-allocates zero-initialized `[B, capacity, dim]` buffers. `append_packed` writes directly into buffer at `filled_len` offset using `as_f32_view_mut()` (new method on `TensorStorage`). `packed_keys()`/`packed_values()` return sliced view `[0..filled_len]` via `Slice` op. `truncate()` just decrements `filled_len` — no reallocation.
- Added `ArrayViewMutD` import to dtype.rs, `as_f32_view_mut()` method on `TensorStorage`.
- `init_kv_cache_for_seq_len` in transformer.rs now calls `set_packed_capacity` instead of `set_packed`.
- Legacy growable path (set_packed without pre-allocation) preserved for backward compat.

### 2. MultimodalLLM decode_step O(seq_len) → O(1) (src/nn/multimodal.rs)
- **Problem**: `decode_step` appended new token embedding to `memory.encoding` (full hidden states), re-ran ALL decoder blocks on ENTIRE sequence, cloned+cleared KV caches every step.
- **Fix**: `decode_step` now processes only the new token's embedding through decoder blocks with KV caches installed from memory. `memory.encoding` stores only last hidden state `[B, 1, d_model]`. `prefill` and `prefill_audio` now extract last token hidden state and pre-allocate KV caches with capacity (prefill_len + 4096).

### 3. MultimodalLLM Module::forward no-op → working text-only forward (src/nn/multimodal.rs)
- **Problem**: `Module::forward` just logged warning and returned input unchanged. VL models errored when used through generic Module interface.
- **Fix**: Implemented proper text-only forward: embed tokens → decoder blocks (no cache) → head → logits.

## Build Status
- `cargo check --no-default-features` — clean, zero warnings
- `cargo check --features server --no-default-features` — clean
- `cargo check --all-features` — clean
- Tests: 8/8 KV cache tests pass, 35/35 transformer tests pass, 2/2 generation tests pass, 1/1 vision test pass

## Known Pre-existing Issue (NOT caused by these changes)
- `test_kronos_loader_projector_and_vision_head_decoder` hangs — confirmed pre-existing by stashing changes and retesting. Likely deadlock in `apply_state_dict_to_module` → `load_state_dict` when same tensor Arc is locked twice. Separate issue to fix.
